sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the mandatory upper-end attachment for main and intermediate ice frames and the conditional horizontal-member alternative for intermediate ice frames, with correct targets, support alternatives, distinct adjacent main frames, boolean evidence, and exception applicability.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Split the main-frame and intermediate-ice-frame logic. Retain the direct-attachment requirement to deckStructure, tankBoundaryPlating, or iceStringer, but for an intermediateIceFrame that hasTerminationAboveSupportingStructure a deck/stringer with supportingStructureAtOrAboveIceBeltUpperLimit true, add the permitted alternative in which its upper end hasHorizontalConnectionMember a horizontalConnectionMember that connectsToAdjacentMainFrame and has sameScantlingsAsMainFrame true. Do not make ordinaryFrameScantlingsUsed mandatory, since that clause is permission rather than required evidence. The current unconditional shared shape falsely rejects the expressly permitted intermediate-frame arrangement.

Repair both mandatory attachment branches so they inspect the upper end of each frame's strengthened part, not an upper end directly on the mainFrame/intermediateIceFrame: traverse nltl:hasComponent to a node typed nltl:frameStrengthenedPart, then nltl:hasUpperEnd and nltl:hasAttachedSupportingStructure. Keep the permitted termination/horizontal-member alternative only for intermediate ice frames, but require the horizontal member to connect to the adjacent main frames rather than allowing a single main-frame connection; encode at least two distinct nltl:connectsToAdjacentMainFrame values, each typed nltl:mainFrame.

Candidate faithfully encodes the mandatory upper-end attachment for main and intermediate ice frames and the conditional horizontal-member alternative for intermediate ice frames, with correct targets, support alternatives, distinct adjacent main frames, boolean evidence, and exception applicability.
